title: Motion Mamba 2.0: Autoregressive Diffusion Mamba for Long-Horizon Humanoid Control
summary: Long-horizon, real-time controllable motion generation is essential for interactive animation and humanoid robotics, where an agent must respond to changing instructions and spatial goals while moving. Existing autoregressive diffusion methods generate motion incrementally, but bounded attention caches limit access to…

title: WorldLeague: Benchmarking Physical Agency
summary: WorldLeague benchmarks 13 AI systems on 60 simulated robot tasks spanning exploration, rearrangement, and adaptation, measuring progress and success to compare autonomous physical goal achievement.

title: Antom 3-in-1 Transformer: A Payment Foundation Model
summary: We report the development of Antom 3-in-1 Transformer, a payment foundation model that integrates sequence, tabular, and graph representations for payment risk detection. The model contains approximately 7B parameters, with approximately 1.7B activated per task route. Antom 3-in-1 Transformer is pretrained to learn re…

title: Embo-Harness: Towards Understanding Frontier-Model-as-Policy Harness
summary: A systematic framework shows that frontier multimodal models can serve as robot policies when harnessed with interfaces favoring native visual reasoning and tool use, achieving high success in simulated and real manipulation tasks.

title: Don't Sleep, Keep Watch: Proactive Perception for Computer-Use Agents
summary: NightWatch adds a lightweight streaming watcher to vision-language computer-use agents to keep perception synchronized with dynamic interfaces, reducing latency and wasted time while maintaining or improving task success.

title: Real2SimLab: A Unified Platform for Real-to-Simulation Transfer
summary: Real-to-simulation transfer, which builds simulations from real-world observations, has long been studied in research and industry. Recently, coding agents have become capable of generating simulation programs from video recordings, and several benchmarks have been proposed to evaluate them. However, each individual b…

title: Lazy Agents Answer Against Their Own Beliefs: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Beliefs Teaches Them to Act on What They Believe
summary: A reinforcement learning method rewards agents for delaying commitment until their inferred posterior over answers is sufficiently narrow, improving evidence-based answering across vision-language benchmarks.

title: Rewirable Circuits in Transformers with Loom Attention
summary: We propose loom attention, which allows a Transformer to dynamically rewire its circuits at every token by interweaving a head's vertical attention over the outputs of earlier heads (to obtain its query, key and value) with its horizontal attention over tokens. We instantiate vertical attention efficiently with normal…

title: Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence
summary: Establishing effective scaling laws for medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remains a persistent and fundamental challenge. Our systematic evaluation shows that existing medical MLLMs tend to underperform frontier general-purpose MLLMs across a range of medical tasks, while scaling model size primarily im…

title: ACAP: Asynchronous Coding Agents for Efficient Robot Control
summary: Coding agents can construct and revise robot behavior during execution, but using one agent for the whole robot can delay otherwise independent work. We introduce Asynchronous Coding Agents as Policy (ACAP), an asynchronous framework that organizes one robot as a team of persistent agents. Each member reasons and acts…

title: 3AGameFactory-Motion: Agentic Rigging and Reliable Complex Motion Generation for Diverse 3D Assets
summary: A new benchmark evaluates rigging and motion generation across six 3D morphology categories, compares specialized, video-based, and agent-driven paradigms, and proposes an agentic framework that writes compact parametric skeleton and motion programs executed deterministically for reliable control.

title: Let the Fixer Decide: Training a Code Localizer from the Fixer's Likelihood
summary: A code localizer is trained with scores from a frozen fixer via weighted supervised fine-tuning, improving bug localization and patch success for a small coding agent without tests or reinforcement learning.

title: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer
summary: A Mixture-of-Loops Transformer reuses key-value memory across loops and depths, and its U-shaped variant improves pretraining efficiency and inference latency.

title: A Glimpse of Training VLMs as Foundation Models for Robotic Manipulation
summary: nanoAstra combines semantic action modeling with capability-preserving supervised fine-tuning to train vision-language models for generalizable robot manipulation, achieving strong zero-shot success and faster streaming execution.

title: WeMM-Ecom: Advancing Multimodal Content Understanding for WeChat E-Commerce
summary: WeMM-Ecom, a family of multimodal large language models spanning dense and mixture-of-experts sizes, is trained with continued pre-training and hybrid-thinking post-training to achieve strong e-commerce and general-purpose results and is deployed in WeChat.

title: DyLoMo-DiT: Dynamic Looped Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Transformers
summary: A dynamic looped mixture-of-experts diffusion transformer reuses shared parameters and varies compute across noise levels, improving image generation quality under matched budgets.

title: VibeVideoAgent: Closing the Perceptual Loop for Code-Driven Video Generation
summary: Code-driven video generation asks a coding agent to write and run rendering programs. This gives exact control over typography, data visualizations, synchronized audio, and multi-shot scenes, and it leaves an editable project behind. A program that exits cleanly can still render overlapping labels, a camera aimed away…

title: Self-Evolving Evaluation Environments for Computer-Use Agents
summary: CUA-SEE is a closed-loop evaluation environment that co-evolves tasks and executable verifiers to adaptively measure computer-use agents’ capabilities, boundaries, and progress reliability.

title: Innata-0: A Native Embodied World System with Model-Agent Co-Design
summary: Innata-0 is a native embodied world system that co-designs a world-action model and an agent to enable reliable long-horizon physical behaviors through integrated understanding, prediction, action generation, memory, verification, and recovery.

title: Improving and Expanding Video Editing Capabilities Without Videos
summary: Image-to-Video Transfer improves pretrained video editors by training them as image editors on single images, enabling new video editing tasks and state-of-the-art results on OpenVE-Bench and OpenVE++.

title: PyRUA-Dex: Learning Programmatic Policies for Dexterous Bimanual Manipulation with Coding Agents
summary: A framework enables coding agents to develop dexterous manipulation policies without demonstrations by exploring and distilling successful attempts into a program, then refining it for strong simulated and real-world results.

title: ViDecide: Teaching Video Diffusion Models to Reason and Plan Step by Step
summary: ViDecide trains video diffusion models to make causal state-transition and stopping decisions, using Corrective Fine-tuning to improve multi-step planning success without policy gradients.

title: S-Mind: Internalizing Multi-View Geometry for Spatial Intelligence
summary: Spatial intelligence, the ability to reason about 3D space from visual observations, becomes essential as multimodal large language models (MLLMs) move into the physical world. Beyond perceiving each view, it rests on two cornerstones of human cognition: fusing multiple views into one coherent 3D scene and mentally tr…

title: PartAgent: Agentic 3D Part Segmentation via Expert Integration and Closed-Loop Refinement
summary: A training-free agentic framework integrates pretrained 3D and 2D experts with closed-loop refinement to achieve state-of-the-art 3D part segmentation across multiple benchmarks.

title: AutoPILOT: A Visual Agent Harness for Real-Time Gameplay
summary: A harness that lets multimodal foundation models emit primitive actions, open-loop macros, or closed-loop controllers improves real-time game performance and reduces API cost.

title: Composable Soft-Prompt Distillation of RL Experts: Toward Continual Post-Training
summary: RL post-training typically produces domain experts that must then be consolidated into one model, and as new experts keep arriving, this consolidation becomes a continual process. Weight merging and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) must re-consolidate the whole model whenever an expert is added, and can ero…

title: Embodied AI Fails the Mirror Test: How a Simple Mirror Breaks Robot Policies
summary: A new benchmark shows that many robot manipulation policies perform worse when mirrors are present, often because they confuse reflections with real objects rather than simply colliding with the mirror.

title: LingSante MedGuard Technical Report
summary: As medical AI is increasingly used for patient consultation and clinical decision support, identifying harmful, non-compliant, or ethically problematic responses is essential for responsible deployment. Assessing these risks requires checking clinical claims against relevant evidence, verifying calculations, and apply…

title: Plan4D: Generative Plannable 4D Worlds
summary: Most world models for future prediction prioritize aestetic quality of generated videos, but offer only weak physical grounding and limited geometric consistency over time, due to the lack of explicit 4D modeling. In this paper, we introduce plan4d, a possible next milestone towards building a generative plannable 4D…

title: World Models as Native Latent Action Models
summary: Native LAM distills compact latent actions from a pretrained video diffusion transformer via learnable dynamics registers, and PAWlicy uses these actions to pretrain VLA policies without generating video, achieving strong robotic control and cross-embodiment transfer.

title: DocSEAM: Bidirectional Cross-Page Encoding for Multi-Page Document Understanding
summary: DocSEAM is a lightweight module between a pretrained vision encoder and language model that enriches page visual tokens with neighboring-page context via center-anchored masked self-attention, improving multi-page document VQA and reducing boundary sensitivity.

title: Unlocking the Power of Loops in Pretrained LLMs with Loop Residuals
summary: LoopRes enables pretrained large language models to benefit from looped computation by letting layers attend to recent earlier loops with trainable loop-aware keys, yielding consistent gains and improved test-time scaling.

title: KMed-31B Technical Report
summary: We present KMed-31B, a medical large language model post-trained from an open-weight model for on-premises deployment with limited hardware. Post-training a model for diverse medical tasks remains difficult, because improving one kind of task can lower performance on another. We attribute this to differences between t…

title: HOG-WAM: Improving Visual Robustness through Future Gradient Prediction
summary: HOG-WAM improves visually robust control in world-action models by adding future Histograms of Oriented Gradients as auxiliary structural supervision through a training-only HOG diffusion transformer, yielding higher success under observation corruptions while preserving the original RGB-to-action inference architectu…

title: Qwen-Image-HD: Autoregressive Diffusion for High Definition Image Generation
summary: Fine-tuning a generator on a complete high-resolution canvas requires long image sequences and substantial computation, yet local regions can still exhibit unnatural repetitive stripes when training resources are limited. We introduce Qwen-Image-HD, which adapts Qwen-Image 2.0 to high-resolution synthesis through loca…

title: RUIBench: What Makes a Good Robot-Use Interface?
summary: Foundation models can reason about complex physical tasks, yet translating this intelligence into reliable robot execution remains challenging. We argue that a critical, often overlooked factor is the robot-use interface (RUI), which determines how agents express and execute physical actions. To systematically study i…

title: Beam Model Technical Report
summary: Beam is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts language model optimized for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads, using large-scale asynchronous reinforcement learning, long-context midtraining, quantization, and speculative decoding to deliver strong reasoning and safety with efficient inference.

title: Distilling Visual Agents from Limited Interaction Experience
summary: A few selected interaction trajectories combined with on-policy distillation allow a small visual agent to transfer broadly and recover most of a larger teacher's performance with minimal online experience.

title: ThinkMorph-SSL: Scaling Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning with Pretext Tasks
summary: A two-stage training approach uses visual pretext tasks to generate interleaved image-text reasoning traces and automatically built demonstrations, improving multimodal reasoning over instruction tuning alone.

title: ViDiHand2: Unifying Video Diffusion Priors and Hand Geometry for 3D Hand Motion Reconstruction in the Wild
summary: Learning robot manipulation from egocentric human videos requires accurate metric 3D hand motion. Recent methods leverage pretrained video diffusion model (VDM) priors to recover occluded hands directly from full-frame videos, but their appearance-based depth regression generalizes poorly to unseen cameras.
